name: sortKey

name: actionRow
meaning: the item's action row -> query +0x38: action[+7].+0x22 == item row and .+0x34 == this row's name word on 64/64 rows

name: nameWord
readers_found_by_sweep: 0031C7B7* movzx ecx, word ptr [rax + 8] | 0031C7F5* movzx edx, word ptr [rax + 8]

name: price

meaning: unit price in gil -> query +0x28, which the shop list filler takes as the buy price and halves for the sale price (0057DFD0 / 0057DFDB); Potion 60, Hi-Potion 180
